title: Base change compatibility of the direct-image counit
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a smooth projective curve over $k$ [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve] whose structure morphism is geometrically integral [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $\sigma:\operatorname{Spec}(k)\to X$ be a $k$-rational point [def-pc-rational-point]. Assume that for every scheme $T$ over $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ the module category on $X_T$ has injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For a morphism $i:T'\to T$ over $k$ and an object $\mathcal L\in F(T)$ of the invertible-direct-image subfunctor [def-pc-f-subfunctor] of the normalized Picard functor [def-pc-pic-sigma-functor], the pullback along the induced base-change map of the adjunction counit $f_T^*f_{T,*}\mathcal L\to\mathcal L$ is isomorphic as an arrow to the counit $f_{T'}^*f_{T',*}(i_X^*\mathcal L)\to i_X^*\mathcal L$ for the pulled-back object.

proof.text: Instantiate [lem-pc-counit-base-change-is-iso] with f = pullback.snd for T, f\prime = pullback.snd for T\prime, g = i.left and g\prime = baseChangeMap. Smoothness makes f flat and locally of finite presentation [lem-pc-smooth-flat], while properness is preserved by base change. The underlying Picard representative is invertible; the two components of membership in F(T) are exactly h0 and hq of the comparison lemma. This gives IsIso beta for the canonical adjoint map.

Define c using Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp and pullbackCongr for the square. The inverse-adjoint identity homEquiv_counit followed by symm_apply_apply gives f\prime^* beta followed by the counit equal to c.inv followed by the pulled-back counit. Let e be the inverse of fromSkeletonToSkeletonIso on g\prime^*M, identifying this module with the representative of Pic.map g\prime L. The domain edge is c followed by pullback f\prime of asIso beta followed by pullback f\prime of pushforward f\prime of e. The codomain edge is e. Naturality of the counit, the inverse-adjoint identity, associativity and c.hom_inv_id verify the square. Arrow.isoMk constructs the asserted isomorphism. This uses the canonical Mathlib adjunction directly, without any tensorPullback bridge.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_arrowIso_pullback_directImageCounit (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ X ↘ Spec (.of k) = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) [∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), HasInjectiveResolutions (Limits.pullback (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) T.hom).Modules] {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (i : T' ⟶ T) (ℒ : (picardFunctorInvertibleDirectImage (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) σ hσ).toFunctor.obj (op T)) : Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((Modules.pullback (baseChangeMap (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) i)).map (Pic.directImageCounit (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) T ℒ.1.1)) ≅ Arrow.mk (Pic.directImageCounit (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) T' (Pic.map (baseChangeMap (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) i) ℒ.1.1)))
